scripts.api:dev:raw: cd backend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npm run dev
scripts.dev:ui:raw: cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npx ng serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --poll 1000 --configuration=local
scripts.dev:stack: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && concurrently -c auto -n api,ui "npm run api:dev:raw" "npm run dev:ui:raw"
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npx ng build
scripts.db:up: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/db.sh up
scripts.db:down: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/db.sh down
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/db.sh reset
scripts.db:sync-remote: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/sync-remote-to-docker.sh
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/seed-local-docker.sh
scripts.db:import-csv: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs node scripts/import-csv-dir.cjs
scripts.db:apply-migrations: node scripts/sync-stack.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs node scripts/apply-repo-migrations.cjs
